goal: Restore a plausible clean guitar waveform from wet audio without changing source geometry or silently degrading difficult inputs.

architecture.order: per-chain forward order, never a global genre order
architecture.restore: remove stages in reverse forward order
architecture.unknown: rank candidate graphs using order evidence, forward replay, clean prior, and intermediate-state validity; abstain when the margin is insufficient
architecture.context: each inverse stage targets its immediate predecessor but receives only the current effect Wet, controls and own state; any upstream effects are signal content in the target, never conditioning metadata

rounds.reason: energy shrinkage without sufficient waveform recovery
cross-domain average gains were small and tail error regressed
license-clean scratch model missed restoration and tail gates
EGFx held-out ESR, SI-SDR, and P95 gates failed
wider model and two-clip sampling did not improve held-out group generalization
real ProCo RAT audit recovered median spectrum and high-band energy but only 0.51 percent median transient definition; per-example pass fraction was 5.94 percent
confidence selection cannot promote a restorer that fails perceptual quality
portable parity proves reproduction of the rejected model, not restoration quality
quality improved but long-context runtime exceeded speed and memory gates
final chain passed but intermediate-stage consumer gates were misassigned
reduced fit coverage missed final-chain development gates
Tele seal aligned ESR improved 0.825 percent, below the frozen 1.0 percent gate; every other final and runtime gate passed
new DAFx test seal improved absolute ESR 2.86 percent but missed aligned ESR and SI-SDR gates
real DAFx train composite fitting and untouched test records 64:128 passed all quality, order, seal, and runtime gates
automated gates passed but the phrase closed only 1.27-2.83 percent of the Wet-to-Clean distance and remained perceptually near-identical to Wet

previously_accepted_numeric_evidence.scope: ASRNN ProCo RAT plus a performance-group-held-out EGFx RAT domain

portable.backend: ONNX learned core with native spectral contract

unaccepted: general or arbitrary RAT restoration outside ASRNN and EGFx development domains
multi-effect reconstruction promotion beyond the accepted DAFx Dataset 3 development seal
native Rust STFT/iSTFT implementation of the accepted ONNX core contract
execution inside the realtime audio callback
next: freeze a family-independent stage contract, clean-profile contract, and universal anti-degradation gates
train separate nonlinear, dynamics, modulation, echo, and ambience experts independently; test learned sharing only after frozen equal-scope experts prove no negative transfer
treat RAT, TS9, BD-2, Big Muff, CS-3 and other named pedals as adapters and physical validation domains rather than standalone architectures
require effect-specific gates plus phrase-level Wet, candidate, and original predecessor blind listening before any family or chain promotion
